crossRefs.note: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
crossRefs.keyword: not grown up. Heb. hidden, or dark

translations.web: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.
translations.bsb: but the wheat and spelt were not destroyed, because they are late crops.)
translations.kjv: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
translations.asv: But the wheat and the spelt were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
